item.title: 'Like my sister': Family, friends remember woman fatally stabbed in Orange County
item.description: HILLSBOROUGH, N.C. (WNCN) -- An Orange County man accused of fatally stabbing his housekeeper Friday remains in custody in southwestern Virginia, where he awaits extradition to North Carolina. item.title: Upstate taproom closes 'until further notice' due to new liquor liability laws
item.description: GREENVILLE, S.C. (WSPA) -- The People's Tap in Greenville has closed after the business said it failed to secure a liquor liability insurance policy that meets updated state requirements. The bar, located at 250 Riverplace, said it was informed that its renewal policy was non-compliant on the day the coverage was set to take effect. [...]
